snippet.title: Silly Polly Beast ✖ October 2025 ✖ PC, PS, Xbox
snippet.description:
Finally happy to announce: SILLY POLLY BEAST launches this October on PC, PS4, PS5, and Xbox One and Series X|S!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1598780/Silly_Polly_Beast

Silly Polly Beast is a story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, was forced to study its nature. Perpetually unlucky Polly escapes a nightmarish orphanage... only to find herself trapped in the underworld.
